title: Distinct Echo Substrings
description: Return the number of distinct non-empty contiguous substrings of `text` that can be written as the concatenation of some string with itself (i.e., of the form `a + a` where `a` is non-empty).
constraints: text consists of lowercase English letters.
hints: Precompute polynomial rolling hashes (or 64-bit / double hashes) so any two substrings can be compared in O(1).
For each even half-length L from 1 to n // 2, slide across indices i checking if hash(i, i + L) == hash(i + L, i + 2*L) and store matching hashes in a set.

examples.explanation: The 3 distinct echo substrings of "abcabcabc" are "abcabc", "bcabca", and "cabcab".
The 2 distinct echo substrings of "leetcodeleetcode" are "ee" and "leetcodeleetcode".
